purpose: Chef-facing non-diegetic intro/teaser production contract. Editorial pages hook through character, embodiment, self-conception and relationship rather than recapping systems or policy.
intendedPlacement: For each issue, *_INTRO is inserted immediately before canonical story page P01 in the finished issue; *_TEASER is inserted immediately after the final canonical story page. Editorial pages are intentionally stored outside the flat 204-story-page assembler shelf so canonical story IDs and continuity remain stable.
rules: Intros re-arm the person: who is under pressure, what they believe about themselves, and what immediate choice is becoming unavoidable.
Teasers expose the next character collision without giving away the next issue's solution or late reversal.
Social commentary must emerge through a person or relationship; do not turn editorial pages into policy summaries.
Bodies remain tactile and materially specific under the same Division Threshold materiality doctrine as interiors.
Exact caption text is production data. No invented environmental text, taglines or extra copy.
No panel grid unless the recipe explicitly requests one; default is a single editorial splash.
